title: Get subscription details of a developer app
content_data:
Use this endpoint to get the subscription details of a developer app. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/subscription/get/|/v1.3/subscription/get/| |Request parameter name|`object`|`subscribe_entity`| |Request parameter data type|`app_id`: number|`app_id`: string| |Response parameter name|`list`
`url`
`object`|`subscriptions`
`callback_url`
`subscribe_entity`| |Response parameter data type |`app_id`: number
`advertiser_id`: number
`page_id`: number
`adgroup_id`: number
`ad_id`: number
`subscription_id`:number|`app_id`: string
`advertiser_id`: string
`page_id`: string
`adgroup_id`: string
`ad_id`: string
`subscription_id`:string| |Response parameters deprecated in v1.3| / |`tcm_account_id` | |New response parameters| / | `tto_tcm_account_id`
`lead_source`
`product_filters`
`notify_frequency`| ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/subscription/get/ **Method** GET **Parameters** ```xtable |Field|Type|Description| |---|---|---| |app_id{Required}|string| ID of your developer application. You can find the App ID by navigating to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information.| |secret {Required}|string| Secret of your developer application. You can find the Secret by navigating to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information. | |subscribe_entity |string| The object that you want to subscribe to.
Enum values:
  • `REPORT_DATA_CHANGE`: the data change in any of the reporting metrics `spend`, `impressions`, `clicks`, and `video_play_actions` for one or more ad accounts.
  • `AD_ACCOUNT_SUSPENSION`: the suspension statuses of ad accounts.
  • `LEAD`: leads.
  • `AD_GROUP`: the review status of an ad group.
  • `AD`: the review status of an ad.
  • `TCM_VIDEOS`: the linking of a TikTok video to a TTO campaign.
  • `CREATIVE_FATIGUE`: the fatigue status of an ad, ads within an ad group, or ads within an advertiser account.
  • `API_SERVICE_STATUS`: the status of API service.
| |page |number|The current page number. Default value: `1`. Value range: ≥ 1. | |page_size |number|The page size. Default value:`10`. Value range: 1-1000| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --get -H "Access-Token:xxx" \ --data-urlencode "secret=SECRET" \ --data-urlencode "object=OBJECT" \ --data-urlencode "app_id=APP_ID" \ --data-urlencode "page_size=PAGE_SIZE" \ --data-urlencode "page=PAGE" \ https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/subscription/get/ (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field|Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|The response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message |string|The response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The unique ID of the request. | |data |object|The returned data. | #|subscriptions|object[]|Subscription information. | ##|app_id |string| The App ID. | ##|subscription_id |string| The subscription ID | ##|subscribe_entity |string| The object that you want to subscribe to.
Enum values:
  • `REPORT_DATA_CHANGE`: the data change in any of the reporting metrics `spend`, `impressions`, `clicks`, and `video_play_actions` for one or more ad accounts.
  • `AD_ACCOUNT_SUSPENSION`: the suspension statuses of ad accounts.
  • `LEAD`: leads.
  • `AD_GROUP`: the review status of an ad group.
  • `AD`: the review status of an ad.
  • `TCM_VIDEOS`: the linking of a TikTok video to a TTO campaign.
  • `CREATIVE_FATIGUE`: the fatigue status of an ad, ads within an ad group, or ads within an advertiser account.
  • `API_SERVICE_STATUS`: the status of API service.
| ##|callback_url |string| The callback URL. | ##|subscription_detail |object| Details about the subscription.| ###|product_filters|string[]|The list of API products to subscribe to.

Enum values:
  • `BUSINESS_CENTER_API`: Business Center API.
  • `CREATIVES_API`: Creatives API.
  • `CATALOG_API`: Catalog Management API.
  • `TIKTOK_STORE_API`: TikTok Store API.
  • `CAMPAIGN_API`: Campaign Management API.
  • `REPORTING_API`: Reporting API.
  • `AUDIENCE_API`: Audience API.
  • `STREAMING_API`: Streaming API.
  • `EVENTS_API`: Events API.
  • `ACCOUNTS_API`: Accounts API.
  • `MENTIONS_API`: Mentions API.
  • `TIKTOK_ONE_API`: TikTok One API.
  • `DISCOVERY_API`: Discovery API.
  • `SPARK_RECOMMEND_API`: Spark Ads Recommendation API.
  • `BUSINESS_MESSAGING_API`: Business Messaging API.
| ###| bc_id | string | When `subscribe_entity` is `AD_ACCOUNT_SUSPENSION`, either `bc_id` or `advertiser_ids` is returned.

Business Center ID.
You are subscribed to the suspension statuses of all ad accounts owned by the Business Center. | ###| advertiser_ids | string[] |
  • When `subscribe_entity` is `REPORT_DATA_CHANGE`, `advertiser_ids` is returned.
  • When `subscribe_entity` is `AD_ACCOUNT_SUSPENSION`, either `bc_id` or `advertiser_ids` is returned.

A list of advertiser IDs.

  • When `subscribe_entity` is `REPORT_DATA_CHANGE`, you are subscribed to the data change in any of the reporting metrics `spend`, `impressions`, `clicks`, and `video_play_actions` for these ad accounts.
  • When `subscribe_entity` is `AD_ACCOUNT_SUSPENSION`, you are subscribed to the suspension statuses of these ad accounts, which can be owned by different Business Centers.
| ###|notify_frequency |string|Returned when `subscribe_entity` is `REPORT_DATA_CHANGE`.

The frequency of the notification.

Enum values:
  • `5_MINUTE`: every five minutes.
  • `15_MINUTE`: every 15 minutes.
  • `30_MINUTE`: every 30 minutes.
  • `60_MINUTE`: every 60 minutes.
| ###| lead_source | string | Returned only when `subscribe_entity` is `LEAD`.

The source of the leads to subscribe to.

Enum values:
  • `INSTANT_FORM`: leads generated through Instant Forms.
  • `DIRECT_MESSAGE`: leads generated from direct messages of the associated Business Account.
| ###|advertiser_id |string| The advertiser ID | ###|page_id |string| The ID of the Instant Form that you want to subscribe to.

Note: When `lead_source` is `DIRECT_MESSAGE`, this field will be null. | ###|adgroup_id |string|Ad group ID | ###|ad_id |string|Ad ID | ###|tto_tcm_account_id |string|Returned only when `subscribe_entity` is `TCM_VIDEOS`.

The ID of a TTO Creator Marketplace account.| #|page_info |object | The page information. | ##|page |number | The current page number. | ##|page_size |number | The page size. | ##|total_number |number | The total number of records. | ##|total_page |number | The total number of pages. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "message": "OK", "code": 0, "data": { "page_info": { "total_number": 1, "page": 1, "page_size": 10, "total_page": 1 }, "subscriptions": [ { "callback_url": "https://your.callback.url/", "subscription_detail": { "advertiser_id": "123", "page_id": null }, "subscribe_entity": "LEAD", "subscription_id": "456", "app_id": "789" } ] }, "request_id": "20210315104957010115153194073C1EB0" } (/code); ```
